default_view.meaning: all 382685 Token trajectories represented through exact source-target aggregation of 8801755 Top-1 adjacent-layer segments
default_view.layout: V02 frozen ForceAtlas2 LinLog three-seed consensus

new_endpoint.purpose: Return the exact 24 by 4 expert selections and normalized routing weights for one Token

backend_extension.query_strategy: load expert_id as uint8 and routing_weight as float32 once in one read-only server worker

required_interactions: switch graph population, domain, token class or prompt segment without recomputing coordinates
switch Top-1 transition counts and Top-4 weighted co-occurrence
overlay the selected Token's 24-layer Top-1 trajectory on the global graph
inspect exact Top-4 weights in a 24 by 32 matrix
select an expert node from the graph or routing matrix
zoom, pan and reset the global graph

visual_encoding.global_edges: opacity and width are monotonic in aggregated edge value
visual_encoding.graph_nodes: color encodes layer; size reflects selected-group Top-1 rate
visual_encoding.routing_matrix: cell intensity encodes routing weight; rank-1 cell has an additional outline
visual_encoding.sae_features: horizontal bars encode activation within the selected Token and layer

responsive_breakpoints.tablet: 800px to 1279px: two-column workspace with lower linked panels

accessibility: canvas accessible labels and textual selected-state summaries
color is paired with labels, rank outlines or numeric values
scientific_boundaries: The global graph represents every Token through exact aggregation; it does not draw 8.8 million separate DOM or Canvas paths.
Coordinates are layout-derived and fixed across filters.
Top-4 edges are weighted co-occurrence and not causal flow.
Expert contexts and SAE activations are evidence displays, not automatically validated semantic labels.
The UI must never invent feature semantics when no validated global feature-context cache exists.
